body:
Seen by two independent agents on clean checkouts under load (other Gradle runs on the box), so it is pre-existing, not from the T-196..T-207 fixes:

- ExpenseFormViewModelTest > "a blank name blocks the save and is reported": 2 failures in 3 runs of `:app:testDebugUnitTest --rerun-tasks`, 2 in 2 when `:app:lintDebug` runs in the same invocation.
- ListsRepoTest > setCategoryOrder…, ItemsRepoTest > duplicateForList with nothing to copy…: intermittent, same signature.

Signature: `UncaughtExceptionsBeforeTest`, suppressed cause "Illegal connection pointer" / Room InvalidationTracker refresh touching an abandoned connection from the previous test. These test classes build an in-memory Room DB with BundledSQLiteDriver and never close it in teardown, so the tracker's refresh thread can outlive the test.

Passes on rerun, so `./verify-all.sh` and `release.sh` may need a second run until fixed. Likely fix: close the DB in @After in every class that opens one (one agent tried it in ExpenseFormViewModelTest alone: fewer failures, not zero — the invalidation tracker may need to be stopped or the dispatcher drained first). Check AGENTS.md's Robolectric notes and add whatever the durable fix is there.
title: Android: Robolectric repo/view-model tests flake with UncaughtExceptionsBeforeTest from a Room invalidation refresh crossing test boundaries
